root_idea.summary: The root denotes the fitting together, correspondence, or compatibility of two things.
root_idea.development: From mutual fit and correspondence, the lexicon develops meanings of agreement, adaptation toward a suitable or right outcome, success in a good course, and concurrence or occurrence. The Quran-focused use of تَوْفِيق is conventionally associated with good and success rather than evil.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form وَفَّقَ.
Displayed as the verbal noun تَوْفِيق.
Displayed as وِفَاق, a Quran-attested form expressing correspondence or fittingness.

senses.definition: To bring about agreement or reconciliation; to cause parties to come into accord.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive Form II construction for effecting harmony or reconciliation between parties or things.

senses.definition: Divine enabling or success in pursuing what is good and right.
senses.usage_conditions: In established Quranic usage, تَوْفِيق is associated with good rather than evil and may denote success or enabling attributed to God.

senses.definition: The bringing about of agreement or reconciliation.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence concerning an intended good aim, the noun denotes reconciliation or accord.

senses.definition: Corresponding, fitting, or commensurate; in particular, a recompense that accords with what it answers to.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا, the form describes the recompense as corresponding or appropriate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be right, agreeable, or in accord with what is wished or desired.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an affair or case that proves suitable or satisfactory in relation to a desired outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adapt, accommodate, or direct an affair or a person toward a fitting object or a right course; to prosper it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may take an affair as its object or dispose a person to a thing, a right course, or prosperity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To conform to, coincide with, suit, or match someone or something; to be suitable or convenient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The correspondence may be between things, actions, or an outcome and what it answers to.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To agree, consent, comply, or be of one mind with someone about an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional interpersonal construction for agreement or compliance concerning a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To encounter someone or come upon something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct encounter use, equivalent to meeting or finding someone or something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find an affair agreeable to one's wish or desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an affair or case judged agreeable in relation to the subject's desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To happen, occur, or chance; to befall someone as good or evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The occurrence may be described as the concurrence of an event with circumstances, including a good or bad thing happening to someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A legal document, specifically a pleading.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical legal use distinct from the Quranic senses of enabling, success, and reconciliation.
An adjectival use describing what is not deliberately arranged or fixed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Correspondence or matching between two things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal form for mutual conformity, distinct in form from وِفَاق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The time at which an occurrence coincides, attested for the time of the moon's appearing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal expression identifying the time when the moon's rising occurs.

cautions: وِفَاق is tagged as an adjective in the QAC occurrence while its supplied derivational classification identifies it as a verbal noun; it is therefore presented as a verbal noun used adjectivally.
